name: sap-notes-mcp
description: SAP Notes MCP and web applications with a shared library

scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.lint: eslint packages/*/src && eslint --no-config-lookup --rule no-unused-vars:error --rule valid-typeof:error scripts/*.mjs tests/*.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/*/dist/*.test.js tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.web:start: npm run build && node dist/web/daemon.js start
